title: Home practical guide and safety card: cooling cups
subject: Science (GCSE Biology, Chemistry, Physics)
source: Written for gcse-science/y10 lesson 125 (Home practical guide and safety card: cooling cups (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 125: Insulation practical: reducing unwanted energy transfer. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out which insulating material reduces energy transfer most
equipment: Insulating materials: a woolly sock, bubble wrap, kitchen roll, nothing
Warm water from the tap (adult pours)
safety: Warm tap water only, never boiling
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Wrap three cups in a different material each; leave one bare as a control
An adult pours the same volume of warm tap water into each cup
Record the start temperature of each
Record the temperature every 5 minutes for 20 minutes
Work out the temperature drop for each cup
Plot cooling curves and decide which material insulates best

questions.q: Big question: how could you settle the insulation argument?
questions.a: Test materials at the same thickness, then thicknesses of one material.
